en.docs: A server component built on a fieldset with a legend: a screen reader announces the question before the options. The circle is made from appearance:none and a border, and the mark is a radial gradient in the input's own background, so no extra span is needed and the dot does not drift when the font size changes. The --vibeui-radio-002-* palette is built on light-dark(): the component follows the page color-scheme and lays no surface of its own by default. There are no dependencies.
